description.value: Bruno is an upscale restaurant and bar located inside the Versante Hotel in Richmond's Airport District, occupying a 6,000-square-foot space anchored by a 30-seat bar and an 18-seat community table. The kitchen is built around locally-sourced British Columbia ingredients — Fraser Valley duck, Vancouver Island lavender, Pacific shellfish — served in family-style plates designed to encourage conversation. Its signature Saffron Shellfish Tagliatelle and a rotating menu spanning breakfast, brunch, dinner, and cocktails make it a notable destination in an area close to the YVR cycling corridor.
